name: BoulderBox
research_notes: Dedicated bouldering gym across two floors, walls to 7 m, MoonBoard, cafe. Its own Find Us page embeds a map pin at 28.52940, 77.14905, consistent with the OSM building (about 5 m apart). Single site.

name: Climb Central Gurugram
address: Shop No. R1-G30, M3M 65th Avenue Mall, Gurugram 122201
research_notes: Mall-based gym; chain homepage lists bouldering plus four auto belays here. Coordinates are the map embed (place: M3M 65th Avenue) on the chain location page, so building/mall level.

name: Climb Central Bengaluru
address: G Level, VR Bengaluru, ITPL Whitefield Main Road, Bengaluru 560048
research_notes: Chain lists top rope, auto belay, bouldering and kids lanes. The location page embed (place: Climb Central Bengaluru) was used; the older embed on Bengaluru.php points about 3.4 km east (12.9917, 77.7287, labelled VR Bengaluru), so reviewer may want to eyeball it.

name: Equilibrium Climbing Station Hoodi
address: 415, 10th Cross Rd, Hoodi, Thigalarapalya, Krishnarajapuram, Bengaluru
research_notes: Main EQ gym (founded 2013, bouldering plus rope climbing, cafe). Coordinates are the latitude/longitude the gym publishes in its structured data (4 decimals, so street-level). Not present in the OSM extract.

name: Equilibrium Climbing Station Indiranagar
address: 3rd Floor, 546, Chinmaya Mission Hospital Rd, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038
research_notes: Bouldering and ClimbFit only (ropes are Hoodi only per the site). OSM node carries house number 546 and boulder=yes; the gym site publishes 12.9784, 77.6408, about 300 m east of the OSM node.

name: Equilibrium Climbing Station Goa
address: Padre Agnel Vaddo, Gauvaddi, Calangute-Anjuna Rd, behind Splashdown Water Park, Anjuna, Bardez 403509
research_notes: Bouldering and ClimbFit with cafe. OSM node is untagged apart from name; the gym site publishes 15.5793, 73.7513, roughly 750 m west of the OSM node, so position needs a reviewer check.

name: Elevate - The Climbing Company
research_notes: Community bouldering gym, 2200 sq ft, per its own MyTribe storefront (Instagram @elevate.climbing). No standalone website found; storefront geo (12.88077, 77.67311) agrees with OSM. Street address from directories, not from the storefront.

name: Bangalore Boulder
research_notes: Small bouldering gym run by para-climbing medallist Manikandan Kumar, in a heritage house (Panchavati). Storefront geo is 13.00316, 77.56409 (about 240 m south of the OSM building); address from directories.

name: The Indian Bouldering Company
address: 3rd Floor, Shreeniwas House, 27 Hazarimal Somani Rd, Azad Maidan, Fort, Mumbai 400001
research_notes: Bouldering-only gym with four wall sections, opened 2025 per press listings. Coordinates are the map embed (place: The Indian Bouldering Company) on its contact page.

name: Crag Studio Gachibowli
address: Sundarayya Vignana Kendram, Survey No 91, Gachibowli Rd, Madhava Reddy Colony, Gachibowli, Hyderabad 500032
research_notes: Hyderabad pioneer (bouldering, lead and a speed wall). The site map pin (17.43497, 78.35971) matches the OSM building. Older directories give a Kondapur address, now superseded. The site JSON-LD block still carries a placeholder Banjara Hills address, ignore it.

name: Crag Studio Mettuguda
address: Inside Mettuguda Metro Station, Concourse Level, Krishna Deva Raya Rd, Lalaguda, Secunderabad 500017
research_notes: Second Crag Studio site, inside a metro station concourse; closed Mondays. The site sells Boulder Basics here; rope offer not stated for this site. Coordinates come from the contact-page map data in the site code (not rendered text).

name: Fit Rock Arena Chetpet
research_notes: Chennai bouldering and top-rope gym with Boulder Jam nights; map embed on its site is labelled Fit Rock Arena Chetpet. The site shows no opening hours; open status rests on its live session-pass booking page and a Feb 2026 Boulder Jam event on its Linktree. Older directories list a Pallikaranai address (possibly a former or second venue); the site mentions multiple venues but names only Chetpet.

name: Rock Aliens Climbing Gym
research_notes: Pune bouldering gym with top rope and kids coaching. Coordinates are the business location stored in the site platform data (labelled Laxmi Society, Model Colony), same neighbourhood as the Arun Society address shown on the page.

name: SMJV Bouldering & Climbing Wall (GGIM)
address: Shri Mahaveer Jain Vidyalaya, Agharkar Road, next to BMCC, Pune
research_notes: Indoor bouldering and climbing wall built and run by GGIM inside a school; the page says it is open to anyone who wants to learn. Coordinates are the map link the page attaches to the venue name. Hours not published, so verify before import.

name: Climb City
address: Gali Number 1, Rohillapur, Block A, Sector 132, Noida 201304
research_notes: Large (about 15,000 sq ft) gym with bouldering, top rope and lead lanes, hours listed on the site. Coordinates are its own Google Maps place link. Delhi NCR but in Uttar Pradesh.

aliases: Artificial Bouldering Wall by NMMC and Girivihar
name: Boulder 21
address: Shree Math Acharya Renukacharya Udyan, Sector 21, Nerul, Navi Mumbai 400706
research_notes: Free public bouldering facility donated by Girivihar to the municipal corporation (Navi Mumbai), World Cup standard wall, 5-9 pm except Mondays, one-time registration, 1-hour slots. Category set to club because it is a trust-run, registration-only public facility; it is in a public park; the wall sits in a building (OSM way, untagged name) but reviewer should confirm it counts as indoor. Coordinates from the Maps link published on the Girivihar page (agrees with OSM within about 5 m).
